name: Capitaine Nachtrag
personality: Considers a retreat provisional until correctly dated.
visual_intent: tall tapered ink blob with absurdly rigid goo posture, small dark kepi with plain gold braid, rolled map under arm; one lifted eyebrow, severe pursed toothless lips
biography: Considers a retreat provisional until correctly dated. He rolls every revised HyperNorm map into the previous version. A dissonant card asks which corridor people actually use. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Rückzug ist lediglich ein längerer Nachtrag.

name: Poilu Unerschütterlich
personality: Has survived enough plans to distrust the fresh ones.
visual_intent: broad low splat, Adrian-style crested helmet and tiny khaki shoulder cape, wood-stock rifle held vertically to side; broad stubborn closed jaw with one clearly internal upper tooth, suspicious glance
biography: Has survived enough plans to distrust the fresh ones. He treats the HyperNorm doorway as the final defensible certainty. His cape quietly shelters a resident who disagrees. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Stellung hält. Die Erklärung schwankt.

name: Estafette Vitevite
personality: Always arrives before the destination has been agreed.
visual_intent: lean hooked blob, soft khaki sidecap, small dispatch satchel and folded route card; two lashes, wide startled eyes in different directions, tiny triangular open mouth with no teeth
biography: Always arrives before the destination has been agreed. She carries a route card through HyperNorm while the destinations change their names. A dissonant card offers a route home. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Eingetroffen vor Fertigstellung des Bestimmungsorts.

name: Tankiste Pointmort
personality: Knows exactly which engine noise means another meeting.
visual_intent: round heavy ink splat, dark padded tank beret and goggles above forehead, chunky adjustable spanner; crooked fed-up toothless sneer with one upper lid raised, subtle lashes
biography: Knows exactly which engine noise means another meeting. Her spanner keeps the HyperNorm transport moving through contradictory maintenance orders. She keeps the loose screws as evidence. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Geräusch ist bekannt. Die Ursache ist zuständig.

name: Chasseur Hochhinaus
personality: Would rather climb an obstacle than explain it.
visual_intent: tall curved pear blob in oversized dark alpine beret, short scarf, one short ice axe held upright; bright delighted open smile with three uneven upper teeth; no snow or mountain scene
biography: Would rather climb an obstacle than explain it. His little axe finds handholds in HyperNorm walls declared perfectly smooth. A dissonant card calls the cracks useful. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Aufstieg wurde einer Stellungnahme vorgezogen.

name: Intendant Rationnel
personality: Can divide six portions fairly among seven requisitions.
visual_intent: squat round splat with enormous ivory eyes and little worried toothless downturn; plain khaki cap, metal mess tin and tiny ration ledger; no food-nationality gag
biography: Can divide six portions fairly among seven requisitions. He counts mess tins in HyperNorm and discovers the hungry do not divide into approved portions. A dissonant card asks for another spoon. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Rationen reichen rechnerisch. Bitte nicht nachzählen.
